title: Wired vs. wireless CarPlay: How are they different & which is better to use? - Engadget
summary: You don't need much to get CarPlay going: just your iPhone, a USB cable and an internet connection, assuming you're planning to use navigation or stream music. You simply get in your car, start the engine and your iPhone will connect automatically.
